I implemented `format_value`, `format_result`, `run_repl` and `main` in `minidb/cli.py`. All 13 tests in `tests/test_cli.py` pass. I didn't need to edit the test file.

I didn't run the other test files, such as the integration tests under `tests/`. `Engine` is still a stub in this repo, so I only exercised the CLI against a mocked engine.

One behaviour to know: a `.exit` line only stops processing when it is a line by itself. Any statement text left in the buffer at that point is dropped rather than run, because the leftover-buffer run only happens at EOF.
